name: MOD Efeitos de Cartas Rituais
description: v0.78.73: compact Psycho-Puppet description to fit card text box; all ritual effects and type icons preserved. CPU effect forecast.
author: Otavio

settings.label: RECIPES - Bulk command
settings.description: On Apply, sets every Modified Recipe switch ON or OFF, then returns to Keep individual settings.

settings.label: EFFECTS - Bulk command
settings.description: On Apply, sets every Ritual Effect switch ON or OFF, then returns to Keep individual settings.

settings.label: DEBUG - Show Effect Title State
settings.description: Shows renderer mode, card ID, ritual-origin state, title-glyph matches. Enable only when investigating title colors; no gameplay effects.

settings.label: Millennium Shield - Modified Recipe
settings.description: Use the modified Ritual recipe and Ritual Magic description for Millennium Shield.

settings.label: Millennium Shield - Ritual Effect
settings.description: Battle-only destruction and +500 DEF per Attack Position monster.

settings.label: Yamadron - Modified Recipe
settings.description: Use the modified Ritual recipe and Ritual Magic description for Yamadron.

settings.label: Yamadron - Ritual Effect
settings.description: Generates up to 3 random Burn Magic Cards each turn.

settings.label: Psycho-Puppet - Modified Recipe
settings.description: Use the modified Ritual recipe and Ritual Magic description for Psycho-Puppet.

settings.label: Psycho-Puppet - Ritual Effect
settings.description: Temporarily controls one random enemy monster until the opponent turn; attacks against the ritual Puppet target the controlled monster instead.

settings.label: Hungry Burger - Modified Recipe
settings.description: Use the modified Ritual recipe and Ritual Magic description for Hungry Burger.

settings.label: Hungry Burger - Ritual Effect
settings.description: Gains 500 ATK/DEF whenever it destroys an enemy monster in battle.

settings.label: Fiend's Mirror - Modified Recipe
settings.description: Use the modified Ritual recipe and Ritual Magic description for Fiend's Mirror.

settings.label: Fiend's Mirror - Ritual Effect
settings.description: Reflects LP loss; a ritual-summoned Fiend's Mirror in Defense Position cannot be destroyed by battle.

settings.label: Mask of Shine & Dark - Modified Recipe
settings.description: Mask of Darkness OR Masked Clown OR Masked Sorcerer + Fiend + Spellcaster.

settings.label: Mask of Shine & Dark - Ritual Effect
settings.description: Blocks only opposing Fusions. AI learns after a blocked Fusion; Equips remain valid.

settings.label: Javelin Beetle - Modified Recipe
settings.description: Hercules Beetle + Kwagar Hercules + 1 Insect.

settings.label: Javelin Beetle - Ritual Effect
settings.description: Other allied Insects gain 400 ATK/DEF per allied Insect; first battle destruction each turn is prevented.

settings.label: Gate Guardian - Modified Recipe
settings.description: Sanga of the Thunder + Kazejin + Suijin.

settings.label: Gate Guardian - Ritual Effect
settings.description: Can attack up to 3 times per turn.

settings.label: Crab Turtle - Modified Recipe
settings.description: Kanikabuto + 1 Turtle Monster + 1 Aqua.

settings.label: Crab Turtle - Ritual Effect
settings.description: Sets Umi; battle protection by attacker Type; allied sea-family aura.

settings.label: Fortress Whale - Modified Recipe
settings.description: Mech Bass + 2 Fish.

settings.label: Fortress Whale - Ritual Effect
settings.description: DEF per Fish in hand/field; Umi Magic/Trap protection for other sea-family allies.

settings.label: Garma Sword - Modified Recipe
settings.description: Vishwar Randi OR Succubus Knight + 1 Warrior + 1 Fiend.

settings.label: Garma Sword - Ritual Effect
settings.description: Five extra blades: each battle kill can grant one additional attack.

settings.label: Tri-Horned Dragon - Ritual Effect
settings.description: Ritual Wasteland, +1000 ATK/DEF to other allied Dinosaurs, Magic protection in Wasteland and 3 personal horns.

settings.label: Serpent Night Dragon - Modified Recipe
settings.description: Dragoness the Wicked Knight + 1 Fiend + 1 Dragon.

settings.label: Serpent Night Dragon - Ritual Effect
settings.description: Fear: avoids attack targeting while another legal ally exists; face-down allies revealed by enemy attacks gain +1000 ATK/DEF per ritual Serpent for that battle.

settings.label: Magician of Black Chaos - Ritual Effect
Super War-Lion - Modified Recipe
settings.description: Leogun + Garvas + 1 Beast.

settings.label: Super War-Lion - Ritual Effect
settings.description: +500 ATK/DEF per other allied Beast in hand/field; attacks on other allied Beasts are redirected to Super War-Lion.

settings.label: Sengenjin - Modified Recipe
settings.description: Millennium Golem + 1 Beast with at least 1500 ATK + 1 Warrior with at least 1500 ATK.

settings.label: Sengenjin - Ritual Effect
settings.description: Immune to Trap effects; in battle ignores positive ATK/DEF modifiers on the opposing monster while preserving negative ones.

settings.label: Black Luster Soldier - Ritual Effect
settings.description: Sets Meadow after Ritual Summon; each Ritual BLS gives +1000 ATK/DEF to every other allied Warrior.

settings.label: Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon - Ritual Effect
settings.description: Unaffected by opposing Magic, Trap and monster effects; Dark Hole cannot destroy it even when activated by its own side. Field and Guardian Star rules still apply.

settings.label: Cosmo Queen - Ritual Effect
settings.description: Gains +500 ATK/DEF per other Female on the field; Female includes results of generic fusion recipes that explicitly require [Female]. On the opponent turn, a legally playable Female in the real 5-card hand must be the hand play.

settings.label: Dokurorider - Modified Recipe
settings.description: Temple of Skulls + 2 Zombies.

settings.label: Dokurorider - Ritual Effect
settings.description: Other allied Zombies gain +1200 ATK; evades Level 6+ attacks that would defeat or tie it.

settings.label: Chakra - Modified Recipe
settings.description: Resurrection of Chakra: Wall Shadow + 2 Fiends Level 7+ (excluding Chakra). No ATK/DEF ceiling; OFF uses Vanilla tributes.

settings.label: Chakra - Ritual Effect
settings.description: Ritual Summon: destroy opposing monsters left-to-right; gain permanent ATK equal to half of their effective ATK rounded to nearest 10 with ones 0-5 down, 6-9 up. Ultimate immune.

settings.label: Zera the Mant - Ritual Effect
settings.description: On Ritual Summon sets Yami. While that Zera is on the field, non-Fiend monsters on both sides lose 1500 ATK/DEF; Ultimate immune.

settings.label: Skull Guardian - Modified Recipe
settings.description: Novox Prayer: Kamakiriman + 1 Skull Monster + 1 Warrior (three distinct cards).

settings.label: Skull Guardian - Ritual Effect
settings.description: Ritual-only; +1000 ATK/DEF per other Skull on either field, +500 ATK/DEF per Skull in own real five-card hand.

settings.label: EFFECTS - Ignore Ritual Summon
settings.description: OFF (default): Ritual Effects work only on monsters Ritual Summoned correctly. ON: Effects also activate on monsters placed normally; optional sandbox mode, not the intended gameplay.
